newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S FORINT REBOUNDS VS DLR IN PROFIT-TAKING.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S FORINT REBOUNDS VS DLR IN PROFIT-TAKING.

text.p: The Hungarian forint regained most of the ground it lost against the dollar in speculative morning trade, dealers said on Wednesday.
"The day's movements were dominated by the dollar/mark cross, with currency buying in the morning and profit-taking in the afternoon," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
The forint closed at 153.30/35 to the dollar, only some five pips weaker than the central bank bid and compared with a morning low of 153.75/80 and a 30 pips gap from the bid.
German mark deals dominated today's forex market but turnover was average despite a lively day, he added.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange Swiss franc and Ecu futures attracted the most contracts out of the total 1.26 billion forints turnover.
Mark, Ecu and Swiss franc futures finished mostly lower, dollar and sterling rose and the yen remained steady.
